question: In 1869, who named a new term 'Oecologie' that defined the study of the relationship of organisms with their environment?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ernst Haeckel.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1869, Ernst Haeckel named a new term 'Oecologie' that defined the study of the relationship of organisms with their environment.
 
• Ecology was originally defined in the mid-19th century when biology was a vastly different discipline than it is today.
 
• The original definition is from **Ernst Haeckel**, who defined ecology as the study of the relationship of organisms with their environment.
 
• The term ecology is believed to have been coined by **Ernst Haeckel** in 1869 though its first authentic use was made by Reiter in 1885.
 
• It is used to describe the “economies” of living forms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• One of the first ecologists whose writings survive may have been **Aristotle or perhaps his student, Theophrastus**, both of whom had an interest in many species of animals and plants.
 
• Theophrastus described interrelationships between animals and their environment as early as the 4th century BC.
 
• '**Ramdeo Misra**' is known as the father of Ecology in India.
